svg.text: 14 entity types, 23 subclasses in 6 specializations, 15 relationships. Every specialization is defined by a real NOT NULL type column, so all are disjoint (d) and total (double line).
Main attributes only (full attribute lists: Chen diagram and Phase 1 report). Generated and checked against the live MySQL schema.
1, N, M, P = cardinality · subset symbol opens toward the superclass
How the specializations are stored (single-table mapping):
• ARTIST, ALBUM, PLAYLIST, INTELLIGENCE MODEL: one table each, subclass = ENUM type column.
• USER → LISTENER / STAFF → CURATOR / ADMINISTRATOR: users.role_id → roles;
STAFF = roles holding catalog.write + review.decide (Curator, Administrator).
• SOUNDTRACK alone may be based on a FILM: CHECK chk_albums_film.
• SMART alone has smart_type: CHECK chk_pl_smart.
• requests (pipeline job) needs pipeline.run, which only Administrator holds.
